quantile_definition: Condition-equal mean of independent run packet quantiles; never pooled or linearly merged packet distributions
decision_rule: Frozen A numerical margins are reported independently for full and trim10; registration did not explicitly choose a primary A window. Agreement permits PASS/FAIL, disagreement is PARTIAL and cannot authorize B0. Startup is reported without a new cutoff. External old-reward comparisons are feasibility screens, not causal attribution.
